name.description: The record name, such as `home.example.com`; `*.example.com` only where the provider allows wildcards. A name that exists answers 400

dns_credential_id.description: ID of the DNS credential to write the record with; its provider must have an updater. Required except for the custom provider, which takes none (null or left out)

provider.description: The updater provider; it defaults from the credential and must match it when given; `custom` is the administrators-only custom HTTP provider

zone.description: The zone, used only when none of the credential's domains covers the name; it must cover the name

kind.description: `address` (the default): A and AAAA records that follow the public IP; `alias`: a CNAME to `target`

target.description: The CNAME target of an alias (required for one); an address record takes none (null is the same as none). It cannot be the record's own name

ip_version.description: For an address record: `ipv4` (the default), `ipv6` or `both`; an alias takes none (null or left out)

ipv6_suffix.description: An IPv6 interface id such as `::1` that replaces the last 64 bits of the detected address; only with `ipv6` or `both`, and not for an alias

ttl.description: The TTL in seconds, at least the provider's `min_ttl`; null keeps the provider's default or the record's current TTL

enabled.description: Whether NPMpro keeps the record up to date (the default is true)

url.description: Custom provider only, write-only and administrators only: the https URL called to update the record. `{ip}` (the address of the record type), `{ipv4}`, `{ipv6}` and `{name}` may stand in the path and the query (never in the host) and are filled URL-encoded. It is stored sealed and never shown (`url_set` tells whether one is stored); an empty value keeps the stored one

method.description: Custom provider only: the HTTP method of the update call (the default is GET)

expect.description: Custom provider only: text the answer must contain; without it the update counts as failed. Empty or null: any 2xx answer succeeds

username.description: No-IP and Dynu presets only, write-only: the account's user name. It is stored sealed and never shown (`secret_set` tells whether the details are stored); an empty value keeps the stored one

password.description: Namecheap, No-IP and Dynu presets only, write-only: the Dynamic DNS password (Namecheap: of the domain, Advanced DNS tab; No-IP and Dynu: of the account). It is stored sealed and never shown; leave it out to keep the stored one. At least 4 characters (shorter text cannot be hidden from messages)

domain.description: Namecheap preset only: the domain the record belongs to, as Namecheap lists it. The record name is this domain or a name under it

description:
Adds a record NPMpro keeps in line with the public IP (or a CNAME). The name is stored in lower case ASCII. The zone is the longest domain of the credential that covers the name; without one, a typed `zone` is used, else the answer is a 400 (`error.ddns-no-zone`). A name that exists, a provider without an updater, a wildcard the provider does not allow and an alias with an IP version are refused with a 400. The record is checked at the next cycle.

Needs: Certificates manage
